text: dsh-side-chat 是面向 DSH Web 的侧栏插件，在会话右侧栏提供可并行开启的原生侧聊标签。每个侧聊首次发送消息时才创建临时 agent，会继承父会话已完成的历史、工作目录、模型路由、工具和权限设置，同时保持独立记录；可在同一工作区继续编辑文件，并通过流式消息面板交流。关闭标签会销毁对应侧聊，不影响主会话。适合希望分开讨论、又要沿用当前任务上下文和工作区的 Web 用户；需要 DSH Web 环境，不需额外配置。

dsh-side-chat adds native tabs to the DSH Web sidebar. Each temporary chat inherits completed parent context and the same workspace while keeping its transcript separate. Users can run parallel chats and close one without affecting the main session.
想在主对话旁边开个独立窗口继续聊。
能不能把当前会话的上下文带到另一个临时对话里？
让 DSH Web 侧栏支持同时开几个互不混在一起的讨论。
我想在不污染主聊天记录的情况下让助手继续改同一个工作区的文件。
Can I open a separate chat that keeps the current session context and workspace?
DSH 侧边栏里能不能快速新开一个只属于当前任务的临时聊天？
How can I keep a focused side conversation while preserving the main chat transcript?
I want multiple temporary conversations in the sidebar without mixing their transcripts into my main chat.
dsh-side-chat 的功能「继承主会话上下文」：侧聊首次发送时，从父会话已完成的轮次创建种子，并沿用工作目录、模型路由、预设及权限策略。
dsh-side-chat 的功能「多个独立侧聊标签」：从右侧栏入口或标签内的新建按钮打开侧聊；每个标签对应独立的临时会话和记录。
dsh-side-chat 的功能「流式侧聊面板」：在侧栏标签中呈现侧聊消息和输入框；客户端通过 SSE 事件并以快照轮询作为回退来更新回复。
dsh-side-chat 的功能「关闭时销毁侧聊」：关闭侧聊标签会释放对应 agent，并清理该临时会话的持久化目录；插件卸载时也会处理存活会话。
dsh-side-chat 使用前须知：侧聊继承父会话权限策略并能修改同一工作区文件；关闭标签会销毁侧聊，不能重新打开原会话。

@flyer103/dsh-side-chat README · tarball built with `npm pack`：Then **restart DSH**, open a session, and expand the right sidebar from the session header (**「Open sidebar」** / 「打开侧边栏」). On the sidebar's guide page, click the **「Side chat」** (「侧边会话」) card; the side chat opens as a native tab in that column. (There is no session-header side-chat button and no floating overlay — the entry lives in the right sidebar, also reachable from the tab strip's add control; inside an open side-chat tab, the status bar's **New side chat** button opens another one.) Send the first message: that tab's side chat is created on that send and destroyed when you close its tab. Every click of the guide card, and every press of a tab's **New side chat** button, opens another side-chat tab in the same pane, each with its own side session and a chip numbered within the parent session (**Side chat**, **Side chat 2**, …; 「侧边会话」, 「侧边会话 2」…). Collapsing the sidebar or switching to another tab only pauses a side chat; opening a tab without sending costs nothing. Closing one side-chat tab destroys only that side chat — the other side chats and the main session are unaffected.

@flyer103/dsh-side-chat README · What it does：- **Native sidebar tab** — lives in the session's right sidebar next to the other tabs; no standalone session-header button and no floating overlay.
- **Several at once** — a parent session can hold multiple independent side-chat tabs, each its own ephemeral side session with a numbered chip; open another from the guide card or from a tab's **New side chat** button.
- **Inherits context** — the parent's completed turns plus a snapshot of what the main session is doing right now, taken when that side chat is created.
- **Inherits the agent** — same working directory, preset composition, tools, skills, model routing, sandbox mode and approval policy.
- **Really edits files** — write/edit/bash changes land in the same workspace and the main session sees them.
- **References files with `@`** — typing `@` in the side-chat composer opens a workspace path menu and inserts the same `@path` mention the main composer writes; the pick is text only, so the model reads the file with its normal tools. Directory picks keep the menu open to descend, and sent user bubbles show file/folder references as chips.
- **Isolates the transcript** — side-chat tu

@flyer103/dsh-side-chat README · Compatibility：- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (Desktop profile, Web GUI) — the tested target. This release was verified against a real `dsh web` process in an isolated DSH home with a fresh `web` profile: the plugin launches, the host routes answer (including the SSE route's JSON fallback), and the client bundle is served. The `@file` route added since that run is covered by host-route unit tests rather than a real-process check.
- No `engines.dsh` and no DSH peer dependency are declared, so DSH does not version-gate installation. That is separate from the tested version: newer DSH releases are untested.
- Web platform only (`dsh.client.platform: web`); no CLI/TUI surface.
- Node.js `>= 22`; the plugin itself is dependency-free ESM with no `@deepseek-ai/*` imports.
- UI copy follows the DSH language setting (Settings → General → Language): Chinese and English are built in, and any other language falls back to English. Technical details — host error messages, routes, event and tool names — stay in English.

@flyer103/dsh-side-chat README · Known limitations：- Approval prompts are not shown inside the side-chat tab: the side session inherits the parent's approval policy, and if that policy asks a human, the side session waits. Use a non-interactive policy (for example `danger-full-access`) for side chats that must write files.
- A closed tab cannot be restored: reopening the guide card or pressing **New side chat** starts a new side chat, whose agent is created on the next message.
- P1b, designed but not implemented: model picker, surviving a GUI restart, approval rendering in the tab.
- `@` completion depends on the host file-reference provider and only completes files and folders: `@session` references, `/` commands and skills, attachments and drag-and-drop are not part of the side-chat composer yet.
- The inherited context is a snapshot taken when that side chat is created; later main-session turns are not pushed into an existing side chat, and each side chat keeps its own snapshot.

@flyer103/dsh-side-chat README · Repository layout：| path | role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | host half: routes, live attempt accumulation and the SSE stream, fork seed, boundary injection, per-instance session registry, close/dispose |
| `lib/client.js` | client half: right-Sidebar tab type + guide entry, the per-tab body (streaming messages + composer + usage dock), numbered tab chips, the new-side-chat button and the close handler |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch inserting the `dsh-side-chat` row |
| `scripts/install.mjs` | idempotent installer/remover for a local checkout |
| `dsh.plugin.json` | community manifest metadata; DSH does not read it (official display metadata comes from `package.json` and optional `locale/*.json`) |
| `tests/` | `node --test` unit tests |

@flyer103/dsh-side-chat README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @flyer103/dsh-side-chat
```

Then restart DSH. No transcript, schema or workspace data is migrated or deleted; side chats are ephemeral.
